# Walt Disney Animation Studios

> Walt Disney Animation Studios creates world-class animated feature films, shorts, and Disney+ originals with cutting-edge technology and a legacy spanning from Snow White to Moana 2.

Based in Burbank and Vancouver, Walt Disney Animation Studios combines artistic storytelling with advanced computer graphics and open-source technology to produce imaginative animated content. The studio actively shares research, datasets, and tools with the animation industry while maintaining a vibrant creative culture.

## Studio Overview

- [Walt Disney Animation Studios](https://disneyanimation.com): Official homepage showcasing Walt Disney Animation Studios' legacy from Snow White to Moana 2.
- [What We Do](https://disneyanimation.com/what-we-do): Disney Animation's mission: universal stories in imaginative worlds with compelling characters.
- [Teams](https://disneyanimation.com/teams): Overview of Disney Animation's production, technology, and studio teams and departments.
- [Life at Disney](https://disneyanimation.com/life-at-disney): Disney Animation's studio culture, employee spotlights, and creative work environment.

## Feature Films & Content

- [Filmmaking Process - Zootopia 2](https://disneyanimation.com/process): Behind-the-scenes breakdown of Disney Animation's filmmaking pipeline and production process.
- [Short Films](https://disneyanimation.com/shorts): Disney Animation's 500+ short films spanning theatrical shorts and animation history.
- [Disney+ Originals](https://disneyanimation.com/disney-plus-originals): Disney+ original series including Zootopia+, Baymax!, and Iwájú from Disney Animation.

## Technology & Innovation

- [Technology](https://disneyanimation.com/technology): Disney Animation's technology innovations, open-source tools, and animation advancement initiatives.
- [Open Source](https://disneyanimation.com/open-source): Open-source software and technologies including USD, SeExpr for animation development.
- [Data Sets](https://disneyanimation.com/data-sets): Research datasets including Clouds, Moana Island Scene, and Linear Shell Obstacle Course data.
- [Publications](https://disneyanimation.com/publications): Disney Animation's research publications in SIGGRAPH, DigiPro, and academic journals.

## Careers & Talent

- [Careers](https://disneyanimation.com/careers): Career opportunities at Disney Animation Studios in Burbank and Vancouver locations.
- [Interns & Apprentices](https://disneyanimation.com/interns-apprentices): Internship and apprenticeship talent development programs for students and graduates.
- [People](https://disneyanimation.com/people): Staff profiles and team directory showcasing Disney Animation's creative professionals.

## Community & Events

- [Events](https://disneyanimation.com/events): Upcoming industry events including Animation Y'all Expo 2026 and AfroAnimation Summit.
